Aim for 16 GB RAM and a 512 GB SSD, which is the sweet spot for programming under ₹80,000.

RAM: 16 GB minimum. 8 GB struggles with an editor, a browser and Docker open together. Pick a laptop where RAM can be upgraded.
Processor: Ryzen 7 or Core i5/i7 from the last two generations. Fast chips with good battery life matter more than a gaming graphics card.
Screen: Full HD, 14 to 15.6 inches, and a comfortable keyboard. You will look at it and type on it all day.
Battery and weight: Look for 8+ hours and under 1.7 kg if you carry it around.

Skip gaming laptops unless you do game development or train AI AI. They cost more and are heavy. If you tell me what you mostly build, I can narrow this down.
